name: airians-cafe
description: Airian's Cafe hybrid campus ordering system

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix nest-server && npm install --prefix next-client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start:dev --prefix nest-server" "npm run dev --prefix next-client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix nest-server && npm run build --prefix next-client
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix nest-server && npm run start:prod --prefix nest-server
